name: NordVPN
author: Shaun Hawk <shaun@shaunhawk.com>
description: Control NordVPN from the Omarchy bar: connect, switch servers, auto-connect, custom DNS, and Tailscale coexistence.

barWidget.description: Toggle NordVPN, pick a country, set auto-connect, choose custom DNS, and allowlist Tailscale.

schema.label: Auto-connect country
schema.description: Optional country name or two-letter code used when auto-connect is enabled (for example United States or us).

schema.label: Allow Tailscale alongside NordVPN
schema.description: Allowlists Tailscale's 100.64.0.0/10 subnet and UDP 41641 so both can stay connected.
